scope: Read-only retained frame/input/source analysis; no application execution or heuristic changes.
clock: Guest monotonic; scrot started/completed bound capture time, not isolated paint time.

frames.field_band_ocr: No reliable field OCR; zero-confidence garbage

conclusions: The five-file control visibly contains the entire draft in its first retained frame; its 9.986-second OCR match is not text-entry completion latency.
The 5000-file first draft frame visibly contains only P after xdotool type has exited. This is a real partial rendered state, not merely OCR missing a complete string.

xdotool process completion does not establish that the application has processed/painted all injected X11 input. The evidence is consistent with asynchronous delivery, queued UI processing or delayed rendering.
The second 5000-file frame bounds eventual complete draft visibility by 4.630444 seconds after type start. The entire 4.630444 seconds cannot be assigned either to application work or to OCR.
No per-character X-event times, controller callbacks or intermediate frames exist. Average/per-character latency and the source of the delay remain unmeasured.

details: initState assigns the initial name to TextEditingController.
_validate checks nonempty text and isValidFilename(input, os: Platform.operatingSystem) for each change.
For valid text with no existing error, _validate does not call dialog setState. It calls setState when reporting an invalid/empty value or clearing a prior error.
The dialog source has no per-character iteration over the selected-file collection.
Receive Options awaits showDialog; it calls selectedReceivingFilesProvider.rename only if the returned result is non-null. Cancel returns null; ordinary typing does not invoke that rename call.

validation_dependency.evidence_level: Read-only source inspection; not callbacks observed in release process.

limits: Flutter TextFormField/controller/engine processing and dependency validation costs are not instrumented.
The eager underlying Options list can remain a competing hypothesis; this source inspection does not demonstrate that it causes the observed partial draft.

follow_up_observations_needed: Record high-rate screenshots/video during typing without serial OCR delaying sampling, together with the existing same-clock input bounds.
Record individual synthetic X input event emission/receipt timing or a controlled ordinary single-character input to separate dispatch from application processing/rendering.
Repeat the five-file and 5000-file interaction under identical settings to distinguish one observed delayed state from a repeatable workload effect.

partial_to_complete_bound_5000.qualification: Conservative bounds assuming normal progression from partial to full text: the partial snapshot's exact instant lies within frame 0 capture interval. The lower bound uses capture start, not capture end. There are no intermediate captured frames.
